title: Histopathological Subtype and Cancer Stem Cell Marker Expression in Advanced Epithelial Ovarian Cancer: A Two-Year Progression-Free Survival Study.
snippet: Late detection and significant recurrence rates make epithelial ovarian cancer (EOC) one of the deadliest gynecologic cancers. Cancer stem cells (CSCs) have been associated with chemoresistance and relapse. However, their prognostic significance remains uncertain.
